title: Flip Garden
text: Flip Garden turns market making on Monad into a garden you can see, and a ledger you can check.

title: The problem
text: Placing limit orders is easy. Knowing what you really earned, after fills, fees and gas, is hard.

title: Plant
text: On Kuru, a flip order is a limit order that places the opposite order by itself when it fills. Flip Garden lets you plant a few dollars as flip orders, and watch them grow.

title: Hedge
text: Filled bids leave you holding MON. A small short on Perpl hedges that inventory, and you see the size, the collateral and the cost before anything is sent.

title: Deposit and sign in
text: Bring USDC from other chains with Aurora. Sign in with a passkey through Mera. No wallet extension needed.

title: Ledger
text: Every figure is rebuilt from public chain data. On our example wallet, six checks agree with the chain, with a difference of zero.

title: Board and Gardener
text: The leaderboard ranks gardens by completed round trips, never by profit. The Gardener agent tends your garden inside a mandate you confirm once.

title: Why Monad
text: Monad's speed and low fees make a few dollars of orders worth tending.

title: Plant. Grow. Hedge. Read the ledger.
text: Flip Garden. Plant, grow, hedge, and read the ledger. Live now on the web.
